name: Twinleaf SERF Magnetometer (single-channel)

cost.note: Single-channel sensor + electronics; add mu-metal shielding ~$2-5k

deployment: Live magnetocardiography demos. Used in academic labs as lowest-cost OPM entry point.
bci_relevance: MOST ACCESSIBLE quantum magnetic sensor for independent researcher. At ~$8k + $5k shielding = $13k, leaves budget for recording electronics. Single-channel MCG/peripheral nerve sensing is achievable. Multi-channel brain MEG requires 50+ sensors ($400k+).
